observations: body L4: in the head, the dash after «c)» measures 10.3 pt and the dash of «39–40» is a long dash; transcribed as a dash and a long dash.
body L12, L28, L33: the dashes after the numerals I., II. and III. and before «Solutio» and «Chorda» measure 9.7 to 10.3 pt; transcribed as dashes.
body L13: the dash of the letter-spaced «al–Battānī» is a long dash (5.5 pt).
body L13-L32: the minus signs are printed as long dashes (9.0 to 10.4 pt); they are set as minus signs.

body L14-L17: rule (α) is Ptolemy's theorem in the quadrilateral of p. 201: the square of the chord of the distance is the product of the chords of the first and second sides with the square of the chord of the third side added.

body L21-L22, L24: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXIII) read «202, ter in formulis cos β/2R occurrit, quod emendandum cos β/R.»; the printed «2R» is kept. The correction is right: crd I = 2 sin ((L − L′)/2) times crd II = 2 sin ((L − L′)/2) cos β/R is 4 sin² ((L − L′)/2) cos β/R, and L26 follows from L24 only with cos β/R.
body L23: the bar of the fraction x/2 is printed broken in two.
body L26-L27: the steps are right with cos β/R: twice L24, divided by R, gives R − cos dist. = (R − cos (L − L′)) cos β/R + R − cos β, which is L26, and hence cos dist. = cos β cos (L − L′)/R.
body L31-L32: rule (β) is right: for equal latitudes the chord of the distance is the second side, 2 sin ((L − L′)/2) cos β/R, half of it the sine of half the distance.
